approval.standard: eastward-edges.md 5.1 and 5.5, art-style.md density 3; the Frostline brief (snow lying on what faces the sky, granite and slate, lake ice)
approval.note: The rill into the tarn frozen over, its banks wandering and its jog a bend: one body tone, clear dark ice in short lenses down its middle, wandering cracks, snow banked over both banks, running in under a drift's scalloped lip at the frame's top.

audit.size_class: unsized (the frozen inflow: ground dressing on the ice)
